author_confirmation.confirmation: Explicit project-owner approval recorded in the project session.
author_confirmation.scope: NCI-60 WES and RNA-seq as exploratory descriptive external application only; no accuracy or external-validation claim

supersedes: The NCI-60 exclusion in decisions/publication_route.json is narrowed: the original exclusion was of 'external validation claims'; this record authorises NCI-60 call-level data for an exploratory descriptive application section (S9.6) only.

original_exclusion_basis.reason: NCI-60 and GIAB arms do not meet the active external-validation standard (small, mixed provenance, not the prespecified primary external cohort).
original_exclusion_basis.kept_exclusion: NCI-60 numbers must NOT appear in the abstract, conclusions, primary accuracy table (Table 1), or any external-validation claim. The exclusion of NCI-60 as a primary validation cohort is not lifted.

reactivation_scope.truth_source: Reinhold et al. 2019 (Cancer Research 79:3519–3531; SBT HLA typing of NCI-60 cell lines). Truth-source field in publication_assessment.json records Adams et al. 2005 — the Reinhold 2019 citation governs the manuscript.

permitted_claims: exploratory descriptive plurality concordance against published SBT HLA truth
caller availability and per-gene breakdown as supplementary diagnostic information
illustrative observation that plurality concordance is broadly consistent with the development analysis
forbidden_claims: any accuracy claim that would position this as prospective evidence
any appearance in abstract, conclusions or primary result summary
comparison against MetaConsensus or Champion-Challenger as a primary finding
manuscript_placement: S9.6 only, clearly labelled as exploratory descriptive external application and not external validation
reference_to_add: Reinhold et al. (2019). A Land of Diversity and Heterogeneity: The NCI-60 in Light of Recent Re-Annotations and Current Genomic Data. Cancer Research, 79, 3519–3531.

governance.development_subject_overlap: none (NCI-60 cell lines are not 1000G subjects)
governance.retention_rule: Results are retained regardless of direction.
